"""Read descriptors from existing AMDGPU ELF images; does not execute kernels."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import sys

from read_amdgpu_metadata_r1 import metadata


def read_descriptors(binary):
    images = []
    for record in metadata(binary):
        base = record['elf_offset']
        header = struct.unpack_from('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH', binary, base)
        assert header[2] == 224 and header[11] == 64
        sections = [struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ', binary, base + header[6] + i * 64)
                    for i in range(header[12])]
        symbols = {}
        for section in sections:
            if section[1] not in (2, 11):
                continue
            assert section[9] == 24 and section[5] % 24 == 0
            strings = sections[section[6]]
            assert strings[1] == 3
            names = binary[base + strings[4]:base + strings[4] + strings[5]]
            for offset in range(section[4], section[4] + section[5], 24):
                name_offset, info, other, shndx, value, size = struct.unpack_from(
                    '<IBBHQQ', binary, base + offset)
                if shndx == 0:
                    continue
                end = names.find(b'\0', name_offset)
                assert end >= name_offset
                name = names[name_offset:end].decode()
                if not name.endswith('.kd'):
                    continue
                symbol = dict(section=shndx, value=value, size=size, info=info, other=other)
                if name in symbols:
                    assert symbols[name] == symbol, name
                symbols[name] = symbol
        kernels = []
        for kernel in record['metadata']['amdhsa.kernels']:
            name = kernel['.symbol']
            symbol = symbols[name]
            assert symbol['size'] == 64, (name, symbol)
            section = sections[symbol['section']]
            offset = symbol['value'] - section[3]
            assert 0 <= offset <= section[5] - 64
            absolute = base + section[4] + offset
            raw = binary[absolute:absolute + 64]
            assert len(raw) == 64
            group, private, kernarg = struct.unpack_from('<III', raw)
            assert group == kernel['.group_segment_fixed_size']
            assert private == kernel['.private_segment_fixed_size']
            assert kernarg == kernel['.kernarg_segment_size']
            rsrc1, rsrc2 = struct.unpack_from('<II', raw, 48)
            entry_relative = struct.unpack_from('<q', raw, 16)[0]
            entry = symbol['value'] + entry_relative
            code_sections = [s for s in sections if s[2] & 4 and s[3] <= entry < s[3] + s[5]]
            assert len(code_sections) == 1, (name, entry)
            kernels.append(dict(
                name=kernel['.name'], symbol=name,
                descriptor_file_offset=absolute, descriptor_virtual_address=symbol['value'],
                descriptor_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                kernel_entry_virtual_address=entry,
                descriptor_and_metadata_sizes_match=True,
                group_segment_fixed_size=group, private_segment_fixed_size=private,
                kernarg_segment_size=kernarg, compute_pgm_rsrc1=hex(rsrc1),
                compute_pgm_rsrc2=hex(rsrc2),
                float_round_mode_32=(rsrc1 >> 12) & 3,
                float_round_mode_16_64=(rsrc1 >> 14) & 3,
                float_denorm_mode_32=(rsrc1 >> 16) & 3,
                float_denorm_mode_16_64=(rsrc1 >> 18) & 3,
                ieee_mode=(rsrc1 >> 23) & 1,
                wavefront_size=kernel['.wavefront_size'],
                sgpr_count=kernel.get('.sgpr_count'), vgpr_count=kernel.get('.vgpr_count')))
        images.append(dict(elf_offset=base, target=record['metadata'].get('amdhsa.target'),
                           version=record['metadata'].get('amdhsa.version'), kernels=kernels))
    assert images
    return images


if __name__ == '__main__':
    path = Path(sys.argv[1])
    binary = path.read_bytes()
    print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(path), bytes=len(binary),
                         sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary).hexdigest(),
                         images=read_descriptors(binary)), indent=2))

analyze_step124_amdgpu_modes_r1.py.text:
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import struct

from read_amdgpu_descriptors_r1 import read_descriptors

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<runtime-checkout>')
read = lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda path: hashlib.file_digest(path.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
identity = lambda path: dict(file=str(path.relative_to(B)), bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(path))

bindings = read(B / 'step124-amdgpu-kernel-code-binding-r1.json')
binary_specs = [
    ('single-tail-q1-whole-native-r1.dll', '84e3cedcdf75cb316fa056378afbe31509cc397274b8a62079e33f882f5c8802', 'c2683cd5cb55478099f1adffe47b98e5cef79fba'),
    ('packed-q1-original-probe-native-r1.exe', '38f207e035d25035250160254c61b35fccb7213838c83f48862da584c86d0905', '31695a894aef5d55bba5e2d1ab00a4d179211521'),
    ('step124-convolution-probe-native-r1.exe', 'f63ececaafd4fd5c4ac208a3b295a593111eb5c1fe49e4ec8fa07b920f8f68a3', 'ae2b207b67b52232e016a70fb0523b4842c80db4')]
binary_records = []
for name, expected, commit in binary_specs:
    path = B / name
    assert sha(path) == expected
    images = read_descriptors(path.read_bytes())
    assert len(images) == 1 and images[0]['target'] == 'amdgcn-amd-amdhsa--gfx1151'
    kernels = images[0]['kernels']
    binary_records.append(dict(**identity(path), source_commit=commit, target=images[0]['target'],
        kernel_count=len(kernels), initial_f32_denorm_mode_counts=dict(Counter(str(k['float_denorm_mode_32']) for k in kernels)),
        selected_kernels=[k for k in kernels if k['name'].startswith('_ZN12qrt_sm121_q1')
                          and ('recurrent' in k['name'] or 'convolution' in k['name'])]))
    for row in (x for x in bindings['kernels'] if x['file'] == name):
        code = path.read_bytes()[row['file_offset']:row['file_offset'] + row['bytes']]
        assert hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest() == row['sha256']

source_binary = B / 'step124-convolution-probe-native-r1.exe'
source_code = source_binary.read_bytes()
disassembly = B / 'step124-amdgpu-disassembly-r2'
native = read(disassembly / 'record.json')
assert native['exit_code'] == 0 and native['native_timeout_seconds'] == 15
assert sha(disassembly / 'stdout.txt') == native['stdout_sha256']
assert sha(disassembly / 'stderr.txt') == native['stderr_sha256']
assert (disassembly / 'stderr.txt').stat().st_size == 0
assert sha(B / 'step124-convolution-probe-native-r1.exe.hsaco') == native['input_sha256']
text = (disassembly / 'stdout.txt').read_text()
instructions = {}
for line in text.splitlines():
    match = re.fullmatch(r'\s*(.*?)\s*// ([0-9A-Fa-f]+): ([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}(?: [0-9A-Fa-f]{8})*)(?:\s+<[^>]+>)?\s*', line)
    if not match:
        continue
    address = int(match[2], 16)
    assert address not in instructions
    instructions[address] = (match[1], b''.join(struct.pack('<I', int(w, 16)) for w in match[3].split()))
results = []
for row in (x for x in bindings['kernels'] if x['file'] == source_binary.name):
    counterpart = next(x for x in bindings['kernels'] if x['file'] == binary_specs[0][0] and x['symbol'] == row['symbol'])
    assert counterpart['sha256'] == row['sha256'] and counterpart['bytes'] == row['bytes']
    offset = 0
    decoded = []
    while offset < row['bytes']:
        mnemonic, encoded = instructions[row['virtual_address'] + offset]
        expected = source_code[row['file_offset'] + offset:row['file_offset'] + offset + len(encoded)]
        assert encoded == expected
        assert '<unknown>' not in mnemonic and not mnemonic.startswith('.')
        decoded.append(mnemonic)
        offset += len(encoded)
    assert offset == row['bytes'] and decoded[-1] == 's_endpgm'
    # Any register setter is conservatively retained, not just known MODE writes.
    mode_or_indirect = [s for s in decoded if re.match(r's_(?:setreg|denorm_mode|round_mode|swappc|setpc|call|rfe)', s)]
    results.append(dict(symbol=row['symbol'], code_sha256=row['sha256'], code_bytes=row['bytes'],
        decoded_instructions=len(decoded), every_decoded_byte_matches_original_binary=True,
        code_identical_to_current_whole_dll=True, mode_setters_or_indirect_calls=mode_or_indirect))
assert len(results) == 3

ranges_path = B / 'step124-state-ranges-r1/comparison.json'
ranges = read(ranges_path)
assert sha(ranges_path) == '35369321b5e9b8aafc3bb5e6b22b23c399ec03ab9522276ae67064b155587343'
subnormals = []
for row in ranges['files']:
    if not row['analysis']['subnormal']:
        continue
    path = Path(row['path'])
    assert sha(path) == row['reference']['sha256']
    cells = []
    for index, (bits,) in enumerate(struct.iter_unpack('<I', path.read_bytes())):
        magnitude = bits & 0x7fffffff
        if 0 < magnitude < 0x00800000:
            cells.append(dict(index=index, head=index // 16384, value_row=(index % 16384) // 128,
                              key=index % 128, bits=f'{bits:08x}'))
    assert len(cells) == row['analysis']['subnormal']
    subnormals.append(dict(position=row['position'], layer=row['layer'], part=row['part'],
                          reference=row['reference'], cells=cells))
assert sum(len(r['cells']) for r in subnormals) == 5

record = dict(schema_version=1, kind='step124_reference_state_range_and_native_binary_float_mode_diagnostic',
    utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), source_commit=binary_specs[0][2],
    reference_host='gb10-4t', reference_model='Qwen3.6-35B-A3B',
    native_model_path='D:/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B',
    reference_evidence=dict(file='benchmarks/correctness/gb10-prefix256-step124-reference-20260921.json',
        sha256=sha(P / 'benchmarks/correctness/gb10-prefix256-step124-reference-20260921.json')),
    stored_state_ranges=dict(**identity(ranges_path), aggregate=ranges['aggregate'], scope=ranges['scope'], subnormal_cells=subnormals),
    binaries=binary_records, kernel_code_binding=bindings,
    binary_download_receipt=read(B / 'step124-amdgpu-binary-download-r1.json'),
    disassembly=dict(record=native, script=identity(B / 'run-step124-amdgpu-disassembly-r2.ps1'),
                     stdout=identity(disassembly / 'stdout.txt'), results=results),
    earlier_observer_failure=dict(
        dispatch=read(B / 'step124-amdgpu-disassembly-dispatch-r1.json'),
        native_record=read(B / 'step124-amdgpu-disassembly-r1/record.json'),
        reason='Start-Process returned a null ExitCode. The observer did not accept that attempt. A direct System.Diagnostics.Process observer repeated only disassembly and captured exit 0.',
        native_inference_repeated=False),
    official_format_sources=[dict(url='https://llvm.org/docs/AMDGPUUsage.html', claim='FP32 denorm mode3 preserves source and destination denormals.'),
        dict(url='https://llvm.org/docs/doxygen/AMDHSAKernelDescriptor_8h_source.html', claim='compute_pgm_rsrc1 is at byte48; FLOAT_DENORM_MODE_32 occupies bits17:16.')],
    conclusion='All530 kernels in the actual c268 whole DLL start in FP32 denorm mode3. The exact recurrent and two convolution machine-code bodies match their prepared native probes; their fully decoded bodies contain no mode setters or indirect calls. Entry-mode flushing or an explicit mode change in these three kernels is therefore unsupported as the explanation for the stored reference subnormals. This does not determine the actual later Windows operands, all intermediate behavior, or the cause of the token divergence. The prepared original-operand GPU replays and actual step124 surface comparison remain required.',
    gpu_executed=False, native_windows_operands_compared=False, native_inference_executed=False,
    inference_acceptance=False, performance_acceptance=False, release_qualified=False)
helpers = ['read_amdgpu_metadata_r1.py', 'read_amdgpu_descriptors_r1.py',
           'audit_step124_state_ranges_r1.cpp', 'run-step124-amdgpu-disassembly-r1.ps1',
           'run-step124-amdgpu-disassembly-r2.ps1', Path(__file__).name]
record['helper_sources'] = {name: dict(sha256=sha(B / name), text=(B / name).read_text()) for name in helpers}
local = B / 'step124-amdgpu-modes-original-r2.json'
with local.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
record['private_original_record_sha256'] = sha(local)
public = P / 'benchmarks/correctness/prefix256-step124-native-float-modes-20260921.json'
output = json.dumps(record, indent=2, allow_nan=False).replace(str(B), '<controller-evidence>').replace(str(P), '<runtime-checkout>') + '\n'
assert str(Path.home()) not in output
with public.open('x') as f:
    f.write(output)
print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(public), bytes=public.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(public), disassembly=results)), flush=True)
